vfx.provenance: Design contract written by Claude Code (Sonnet 5.5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-3. Art produced by Claude Code (Sonnet 5.5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-11 from deterministic SpriteFX JSON specs (pin e5867cc), 188 frames, machine checks only; no human 1x readability review yet. Acceptance numbers retuned once against real output (see docs/LONGTIME_VFX.md section 8).
vfx.routing: programmatic spritefx with the 40-colour palette; never PixelLab

hit_spark: Flesh-class contact and generic hit; ward break; core damage
dash_afterimage: Dash and evade for all forms
charge_up: Boss and adjudicator tells in trial
cam_che_tran_phap: Endless hazard zones and wave spawn telegraph
thien_loi_cuc_canh: Core boss strike; trial verdict strike pending reviewer decision
breakthrough_aura_truc_co: Second in-run realm step and profile milestone Khai Lo

common_acceptance.palette: every opaque pixel is one of the 40 palette colours and belongs to the palette variant's declared ramps or ink_01
common_acceptance.size: every frame equals native_px; pivot lies inside the canvas
common_acceptance.border_clear: no opaque pixel in the outer 1 px ring of any frame
common_acceptance.frame_count_and_timing: frame counts and per-frame ms equal the clip entry; no zero-padded indices
common_acceptance.palette_variants: variants of one ID are recolours: identical alpha masks per frame, same tone order
common_acceptance.loop_seam: one_shot clips fade to the last_frame bound; loop clips differ between last and first frame by at most the inherited loop maximum of 1% of canvas opaque change
common_acceptance.audits: spritefx build with every audit enabled and no relaxed threshold; deterministic rebuild gives identical bytes

entries.event: A ward is placed on its socket (place) and when it fires its area pulse (release).
entries.reads: Where the pulse lands and which ward fired it; the ring's outer edge is the hit area.
entries.why_new: Wards are ground-fixed area sources; no inherited effect is a ground ring and none carries six identities.

readability_1x: At 1x the six palettes are told apart by hue alone when shown on a gray floor.
The ring's outer edge is readable as a hit boundary and reaches about 90% of its final extent by release frame 3.
The ground ellipse never hides the ward silhouette beyond frame 1 of place.

entries.event: A treasure shot or fusion shot lands on a stone-class or spirit-class receiver.
entries.reads: That contact happened and what class the receiver is: stone (cool grit) or spirit (violet bloom). Flesh contact reuses hit_spark.
entries.why_new: hit_spark has one palette; the audio plan already splits contact into flesh, stone and spirit, so sight must split the same way.

readability_1x: At 1x stone and spirit are told apart at a glance; both read as contact, not as a pickup.
Frame 0 is the brightest and sits on the contact point; no stray pixels read as a projectile.

entries.event: A craft step finishes: ingot ready at the kiln, herb harvested, ward core repaired, fusion recipe recorded.
entries.reads: The step completed and its result is ready to take; hue says which kind (ingot, growth, repair, fusion).
entries.why_new: spirit_stone_glint means pickup; completion of a crafted result needs a rising burst that cannot be mistaken for loot.

readability_1x: At 1x the burst rises above its source object and does not cover the kiln mouth or fruit.
Bronze, jade and soul are told apart without the surrounding scene.

entries.event: A committing decision lands: five-floor marker, oath chosen, reward banked.
entries.reads: The decision is locked; hue says which commitment (mark, oath, bank).
entries.why_new: Three decisions need one shared seal-landing beat; charge_up and cam_che_tran_phap read as danger, not commitment.

readability_1x: At 1x the landing frame is the clearest frame and the effect is gone before the next input prompt.
It does not resemble a hazard zone: no red, no ring that could be read as a danger area.

entries.event: The moon gate changes from sealed to open when its icon check passes.
entries.reads: The gate was locked and is now walkable.
entries.why_new: lt_moon_gate has two static states and no transition; the change has to be seen, not inferred.

readability_1x: At 1x the seal disk visibly breaks before the opening appears.
Frame 6 hides the sealed-to-open sprite swap; no pop is visible at the swap.

entries.event: The defended core breaks and the defense ends.
entries.reads: The defense is lost: a sharp, final event unlike a ward pulse.
entries.why_new: A loss needs its own one-time crack; reusing a hit or pulse would not tell failure from damage.

readability_1x: At 1x it reads as failure within the first three frames and is unlike hit_spark.
Nothing covers the reload or retry prompt after the last frame.
